title: hive bot status output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive bot status --json`. Reports whether the Telegram bot process is running, its PID, and uptime. Exit code is 0 when running, 1 when not. Wrapper-level extra positional usage errors for `hive bot ... --json` emit the ErrorPayload arm before command dispatch.

running.description: Whether a live bot process holds the PID file.

pid.description: PID of the running bot, or null when running=false.

uptime_sec.description: Seconds since the PID file was written, or null when running=false.

pid_file.description: Absolute path of the bot PID file.

log_file.description: Absolute path of the bot JSON-line log file.

service_installed.description: Whether the per-user autostart unit file exists on disk (non-mutating probe). Always present; null only if the probe itself could not run.

service_enabled.description: Whether the service manager reports the autostart unit as enabled/loaded (non-mutating probe). Always present; null only if the probe itself could not run.

unit_path.description: Absolute path of the autostart unit file; null on unsupported platforms or if the probe could not run.

error_kind.description: An extra positional argument was passed after the bot subcommand, e.g. `hive bot status extra`.
